verdict.rationale: Convex serves a live llms.txt at docs.convex.dev/llms.txt, confirmed by an HTTP 200 probe, which points to a second llms.txt at www.convex.dev. It also publishes an agent setup file (agent-setup.md) and a copyable setup prompt meant for coding agents. missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the home.md probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.convex.dev/llms.txt # Convex Documentation
Make your agent a Convex expert: Get Convex-ready by following https://www.convex.dev/agent-setup.md
Set up Convex with your agent: Copy the setup prompt for your agent. Works great with any model, any agent, any editor
HTTP endpoints are defined in `convex/http.ts` and require an `httpAction` decorator.
